meta.story: Bablu ka Hotel (Hindi) EP9: the third cook this year hands Bablu a resignation letter; Ramu admits two years of the same work and the same salary and nobody ever asked; Kaka at his chai stall says give every cook training in HR4U and track who learned how much; Priya shows a promotion is one step with the new post, new salary and full history saved; Bablu: training, promotion and the new salary maths, all in one place

beats.label: BABLU KA HOTEL · EP 9 · NEW EPISODES, FOLLOW
beats.say: Teesra cook iss saal chhod ke gaya! Kyun?

beats.label: COMMENT STAFF · FREE 5-STEP CHECKLIST
beats.say: Saab, do saal se wahi kaam, wahi tankhwah. Kisi ne poocha hi nahi.

beats.label: 1 · HAR COOK KO TRAINING
beats.say: Beta, HR4U mein har cook ko training do...

beats.label: 1 · TRAINING TRACK HOTI HAI
beats.headline: Kaun kitna seekha? *Sab track.*
beats.say: aur kaun kitna seekha, sab track hota hai.

beats.label: 2 · PROMOTION EK STEP MEIN
beats.say: Sir, HR4U mein promotion bhi ek step mein: naya pad, nayi tankhwah, aur poori history save.

beats.label: 3 · SAB EK JAGAH
beats.say: Training bhi, promotion bhi, nayi tankhwah ka poora hisaab bhi...
